many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    # find template: largest non-zero connected-ish block; find key = row containing many distinct colors
    rows=[r[:] for r in I]
    # key row: row with max number of distinct nonzero colors
    key=max(range(H),key=lambda r: len(set(x for x in rows[r] if x)))
    cols=[c for c in range(W) if any(rows[r][c]!=0 for r in range(H))]
    # template bounding box
    r0=min(r for r in range(H) if any(x!=0 for x in I[r]))
    r1=max(r for r in keys for keys in [])  # placeholder
    # better: template = the block whose cells are all same color AND not part of key row... 
    # just take bounding box of all nonzero excluding key row
    nb=[(r,c) for r in range(H) if r!=key for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=0]
    r0=min(r for r,c in nb); r1=max(r for r,c in nb)
    c0=min(c for r,c in nb); c1=max(c for r,c in nb)
    tmpl=[[I[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    tcols={tmpl[r][c] for r in range(len(tmpl)) for c in range(len(tmpl[0])) if tmpl[r][c]}
    # key colors: colors on key row not in template colors
    kc=set(x for x in rows[key] if x!=0 and x not in tcols)
    seq=sorted(kc)
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    n=len(seq)
    hgt=len(tmpl); wdt=len(tmpl[0])
    start=(H-n*hgt)//2
    for i,col in enumerate(seq):
        for dr in range(hgt):
            for dc in range(wdt):
                v=tmpl[dr][dc]
                if v: out[start+i*hgt+dr][c0+dc]=col
    return out

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def find_strip(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    hr=[r for r in range(H) if len({x for x in I[r] if x!=0})>1]
    vc=[c for c in range(W) if len({I[r][c] for r in range(H) if I[r][c]!=0})>1]
    return 'h',hr[0] if hr else ('v',vc[0])

def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    o,line=find_strip(I)
    P=set((r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if (o=='h' and r==line) or (o=='v' and c==line))
    # keep all non-strip cells as-is; erase strip; then complete each color's shape to template
    out=[[cell for cell in row] for row in I]
    for r,c in P: out[r][c]=0
    return out

for i in [1,2]:
    I=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    pred=f(I)
    print(i, pred==O)

import os,re,json
from collections import deque
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])

        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def comps_of(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r][c]!=0 and not seen[r][c]:
                col=I[r][c]; q=deque([(r,c)]); seen[r][c]=True; cells=[]
                while q:
                    rr,cc=q.popleft(); cells.append((rr,cc))
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

                        if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and not seen[nr][nc] and I[nr][nc]==col:
                            seen[nr][nc]=True; q.append((nr,nc))
                out.append({'col':col,'cells':set(cells)})
    return out

def norm_pattern(cells):
    rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[c for _,c in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    return tuple(sorted((r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells)), (r0,c0,r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1)

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    comps=comps_of(I)
    shapes=Counter()
    for cc in comps:
        rs=[r for r,_ in cc['cells']]; cs=[c for _,c in cc['cells']]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        shape=tuple(sorted((r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cc['cells']))
        shapes[shape]+=1
    tpl=shapes.most_common(1)[0][0]
    copies=[cc for cc in comps if tuple(sorted((r-min(rs'),c-min(cs')) for r,c in cc['cells']))==tpl if False else cc and True]
    # copies: components whose normalized shape equals tpl
    copies=[cc for cc in comps if tuple(sorted((r-min(r for r,_ in cc['cells'])),c-min(c for _,c in cc['cells'])) for r,c in cc['cells'])==(r0,c0) and False]
    # redo cleanly
    copies=[]
    for cc in comps:
        rs=[r for r,_ in cc['cells']]; cs=[c for _,c in cc['cells']]
        normsh=tuple(sorted((r-min(rs),c-min(cs)) for r,c in cc['cells']))
        if normsh==tpl:
            copies.append(cc)
    tops=sorted(min(r for r,c in cc['cells']) for cc in copies)
    cols=[cc['col'] for cc in copies]
    th=max(rs for rs in [min(r for r,_ in cc['cells']) for cc in copies])
    th=max(max(r for r,c in cc['cells']) for cc in copies)-min(min(r for r,c in cc['cells']) for cc in copies)+1
    # step = template height
    step=th
    pos=set(tops)
    while True:
        added=False
        for t in list(pos):
            for sgn in (step,-step):
                p=t+sgn
                if 0<=p and p+th-1<H:
                    pos.add(p); added=True
        if not added: break
    pos=sorted(pos)
    pal=sorted(set(cols))
    # map: each position's color = next in palette order relative to nearest existing copy (up/down), existing keep own color
    def colorof(p):
        if p in set(cols_bytop): return cols_bytop[p]
        near=[t for t in tops if abs(p-t)==min(abs(p-t) for t in tops)]
        t=near[0]
        i=tops.index(t)
        # direction: nearest existing copy's side determines forward/backward in palette
        stepdir = 1 if (min(abs(p-t)) == p-t) else -1  # p > t -> down (+1), else up (-1)
        # forward = palette order increasing index
        return pal[(i+stepdir)%(len(pal))]
    cols_bytop={}
    for t,col in zip(tops,cols): cols_bytop[t]=col
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    # erase palette strip (nonzero compact block far from copies?) use: cells belonging to comps not matching tpl
    for cc in comps:
        if tuple(sorted((r-min(rs),c-min(cs)) for r,c in cc['cells']))!=tpl:
            for r,c in cc['cells']:
                if I[r][c]!=0: out[r][c]=0
    for p in pos:
        col=colorof(p)
        for dr,dc in [(r-min(min(r for r,_ in copies[0]['cells'])), c-min(min(c for _,c in copies[0]['cells']))) for r,c in copies[0]['cells']]:
            rr=r0+dr; ccx=c0+dc
            if 0<=rr<H and 0<=ccx<W:
                out[rr][ccx]=col
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:

        for ri,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(r,O)):
            if a!=b: print(ri,'got',''.join(map(str,a))); print(ri,'exp',''.join(map(str,b)))
